chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, and Ibn Abbas used to say, 'I did not benefit from any speech after the speech of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) more than I benefited from this speech.'

key_terms.انتفاع: Benefit, deriving advantage or spiritual gain
key_terms.عبد الله بن العباس: Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, a prominent companion and scholar

ai.seo_question: What did Ibn Abbas say about the benefit of Imam Ali's letter?
ai.summary: This passage highlights the profound intellectual and spiritual authority of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) as recognized by Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, a preeminent companion and exegete of the Quran. Ibn al-Abbas’s declaration underscores the continuity of divine wisdom, positioning Ali’s correspondence not merely as administrative guidance but as a direct extension of the Prophet’s teachings, thereby validating the Ahl al-Bayt’s role in preserving and interpreting Islamic knowledge.
